name: Torwin
about: Torwin (class 1050), the newest and fastest initiate of the Order of Enlightenment on Argentrock; gone after Windy Point. The topic shows until Cyrrus says where he went (G[116:1]). INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: If a focus is a line to Stratos, is the limit the line or the hand?
say: Well. Finally someone asks a question worth my time. Do not let it go to your head.
The hand, obviously. A focus is only a line. Lines can be doubled. Two lines, twice the flow. Any fool could see it, if they bothered to look.
The elders say a healer who reaches too deep destroys himself. The elders say a great many things. They have never reached at all.
...Why do you want to know? Never mind. Go and heal a hangnail or something.
